kitDescription: Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic is a Wind SR Supporter whose every full-charge sniper shot grants the whole team a stacking Max HP buff (1% of her own max HP per stack, up to 30 stacks, permanent) and fills the team burst gauge by 7.15%. Whenever any ally enters Burst Stage 3, she gives the team +10% Attack Damage for 5 seconds. When she casts her own Burst II, she grants all allies ATK equal to 1% of her final max HP for 15 seconds and gains a permanent +30% ATK Overcurrent stack, up to 5 stages. Her burst also swaps her weapon to the Matis UberBuster — a 1-round piercing cannon hitting at 350% of final ATK with a 300% full-charge multiplier — whose fixed charge time shortens with her Overcurrent stage, from 3 seconds down to 0.4 seconds at stage 5. The same cast buffs the team's Attack Damage by 25% for 10 seconds.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all 8 kit lines are encoded, 7 FAITHFUL and 1 (S2a caster-HP basis) a DOCUMENTED_GAP with estimate + recipe + tier, plus the flagged swap-duration ⚑. The convergence signal is strong despite the RED headline: the S5 blind's 17 reds are ALL the fixture collision it pre-declared in its own header — controlComp pins crown into the Burst-II slot so mom casts zero bursts and every burst-keyed group is VOID, not refuted (a blind-fixture RECON_ERROR, not a driver divergence). Every group that can fire in that fixture is GREEN, including the S5 blind independently deriving the resourceGate-banded charge-time ladder the driver shipped, and the S6 blind — which skipped the ladder as 'the single largest modeling error' — prescribed verbatim the multi-band resourceGate recipe the driver enacted; two independent derivations converging on the driver's re-opened S3 model is the strongest evidence this gauntlet produces. Driver-side discrimination holds: every line has a nearest-wrong counterfactual that flips red (stageEnter vs burstCast frame sets, fixed-3s ladder, 175%/charge-100% swaps, ally-re-scoped Overcurrent), and fire-rate checks pass (per-shot HP stacking to cap, per-cast Overcurrent to cap 5, swap cadence accelerating across bursts). Residual same-model risks for the owner to spot-check against a recording: (1) the post-increment order-of-operations read (cast N's Overcurrent stack feeds cast N's ladder — kit-ambiguous, documented); (2) flag-1's caster-vs-own HP basis on S2a ally grants; (3) the 10s swap-duration ⚑ and ammo-1 reload economy. None blocks GO.
